code:
Base tables ship deliberately generic:

task      -> behind Incident, Problem, Change, Request
cmdb_ci   -> behind every configuration item type

Neither is meant to be used directly very often.
caption: They exist so other tables can build on top of them.

code:

  short_description, state, priority, assignment_group
    |-- extends --> incident        (+ caller_id, category)
    |-- extends --> problem         (+ known_error, workaround)
    |-- extends --> change_request  (+ risk, backout_plan)
caption: Extends table in sys_db_object makes this real, not cosmetic.
